scope: Final integration of v0.2; no device execution

build.note: Core tests and lint report were UP-TO-DATE; counts are from current generated XML. An earlier rebuild attempt was cancelled after the pipe handoff and is not the final result.

lint.note: All seven are newer dependency version suggestions; no suppression added.

checks.root_default: disabled; authorization only after explicit user action

integration_fixes: Deliver structurally complete HAL thermalservice output through the root protocol; reject truncated or invalid frames.
Correct the fixed allowlist test to 479 and check individual limits; normalize source limit boundaries and set PATH.
Use a full shell compound command to prevent write-before-read duplex pipe deadlock; add an unprivileged bounded-pipe regression.
Limit battery root frame freshness to 2 seconds, reject vendor state_of_health as capacity health, and retain only same-battery same-unit capacity ratios.
Display valid capacity-health values through 150 percent without clamping.
Correct CPU temperature provenance, test HAL/sysfs selection with synthetic data, and avoid redundant CPU baseline reset on session transition.
Preserve available-reading explanations in the details UI.
limitations: No APK install, launch, UI interaction, runtime permissions, real sensor or real Root validation was performed.
Root output format and 2-second frame latency vary by OEM; oversized encoded frames fail closed at 512 KiB even if individual sources fit their limits.
Root denial can be indistinguishable from unavailable; blocked worker cleanup may require restarting the app.
Only named CPU regional sensors and complete recognized HAL output are used, not verified per-core junction temperatures; GPU and battery readings depend on available sources.
AGP warns that optional platform-tools is not installed and about the configured experimental aapt2 override; Kotlin reports one deprecated coroutine resume overload.
Debug signing is not production signing; no cross-device, accessibility, performance or battery accuracy validation.
